# Sculpting with Math — Shaders

Complete, runnable shaders for each demo in the notes.

---

## Common Infrastructure

All shaders in this chapter use the same boilerplate: ray generation, orbit camera, gradient-based normals, raymarching, and Phong shading with shadows. Each shader below is self-contained — paste it into Shadertoy and it runs.

The primitive SDFs appear as bare helper functions (`sdSphere`, `sdBox`, etc.) rather than structs, to keep the demos compact. The notes explain the struct convention; the shaders use the shorthand.

---

## punched-sphere

A sphere with three cylindrical holes along the coordinate axes.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.6, 0.55);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p,     0.4, 1.2));
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p.yzx, 0.4, 1.2));
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p.zxy, 0.4, 1.2));
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p,     0.4, 1.2));
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p.yzx, 0.4, 1.2));
    d = max(d, -sdCylinder(p.zxy, 0.4, 1.2));
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.9, 0.3, 0.2);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 5.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## steinmetz

Intersection of three orthogonal cylinders.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {

    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;

    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;

    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {

    d = max(d, sdCylinder(p.zxy, 1.0, 2.0));
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    return min(d, ground);

    d = max(d, sdCylinder(p.zxy, 1.0, 2.0));
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.2, 0.6, 0.9);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);

}

        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 5.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
```

## scooped-cube

A cube with a sphere subtracted from one corner.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.62, 0.55);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }
float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float cube = sdBox(p, vec3(1.0));
    float scoop = sdSphere(p - vec3(1.0), 1.2);
    float d = max(cube, -scoop);
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float cube = sdBox(p, vec3(1.0));
    float scoop = sdSphere(p - vec3(1.0), 1.2);
    float d = max(cube, -scoop);
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.85, 0.75, 0.5);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 5.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## crease-problem-2d

Two circles: hard union on the left, smooth union on the right. Shows the crease vs. the fillet.

```glsl
float sdCircle(vec2 p, vec2 c, float r) {
    return length(p - c) - r;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.5;

    // Left side: hard union (min)
    float d1L = sdCircle(p, vec2(-1.8, 0.3), 0.8);
    float d2L = sdCircle(p, vec2(-1.2, -0.3), 0.8);
    float dLeft = min(d1L, d2L);

    // Right side: smooth union (smin)
    float d1R = sdCircle(p, vec2(1.2, 0.3), 0.8);
    float d2R = sdCircle(p, vec2(1.8, -0.3), 0.8);
    float dRight = smin(d1R, d2R, 0.5);

    // Pick side
    float d = (p.x < 0.0) ? dLeft : dRight;

    // Color by sign
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Zero set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    // Divider
    color = mix(vec3(0.5), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.01, abs(p.x)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## smin-1d

1D graph showing min(a,b) vs smin(a,b,k) for several k values.

```glsl
float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float line(vec2 p, float y, float thickness) {
    return smoothstep(thickness, 0.0, abs(p.y - y));
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 3.0;

    // Two linear functions
    float a = 0.7 * p.x + 0.5;
    float b = -0.7 * p.x + 0.5;

    vec3 color = vec3(0.95);

    // Grid
    float grid = smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(fract(p.x) - 0.5)) +
                 smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(fract(p.y) - 0.5));
    color -= vec3(0.08) * grid;

    // Axes
    color -= vec3(0.3) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(p.x));
    color -= vec3(0.3) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.0, abs(p.y));

    float px = 3.0 / iResolution.y;

    // Draw a and b as thin gray lines
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.7), line(p, a, 2.0 * px));
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.7), line(p, b, 2.0 * px));

    // Hard min: red
    float hardMin = min(a, b);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2), line(p, hardMin, 3.0 * px));

    // smin with k = 0.5: blue
    float sm1 = smin(a, b, 0.5);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.9), line(p, sm1, 3.0 * px));

    // smin with k = 1.0: green
    float sm2 = smin(a, b, 1.0);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.2, 0.8, 0.4), line(p, sm2, 3.0 * px));

    // smin with k = 2.0: orange
    float sm3 = smin(a, b, 2.0);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.1), line(p, sm3, 3.0 * px));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## smooth-union-spheres

Two spheres joined with smooth union, on a ground plane.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.6, 0.55);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float s1 = sdSphere(p - vec3(-0.6, 0, 0), 0.8);
    float s2 = sdSphere(p - vec3( 0.6, 0, 0), 0.8);
    float d = smin(s1, s2, 0.4);
    float ground = p.y + 1.2;
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float s1 = sdSphere(p - vec3(-0.6, 0, 0), 0.8);
    float s2 = sdSphere(p - vec3( 0.6, 0, 0), 0.8);
    float d = smin(s1, s2, 0.4);
    float ground = p.y + 1.2;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.9, 0.4, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),

}

    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 5.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);

        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);

        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);

    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## smooth-subtraction

A sphere with a smooth bite taken out.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.65, 0.55);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float ssubtract(float a, float b, float k) {
    return -smin(-a, b, k);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    float bite = sdSphere(p - vec3(0.7, 0.0, 0.0), 0.9);
    float d = ssubtract(sphere, bite, 0.15);
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p, 1.0);
    float bite = sdSphere(p - vec3(0.7, 0.0, 0.0), 0.9);
    float d = ssubtract(sphere, bite, 0.15);
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.3, 0.7, 0.5);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 5.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## displacement-sphere

A sphere with sinusoidal displacement creating a bumpy surface.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.6, 0.55);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = length(p) - 1.0;
    sphere += 0.05 * sin(12.0 * p.x) * sin(12.0 * p.y) * sin(12.0 * p.z);
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    return min(sphere, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = length(p) - 1.0;
    sphere += 0.05 * sin(12.0 * p.x) * sin(12.0 * p.y) * sin(12.0 * p.z);
    float ground = p.y + 1.5;
    if (sphere < ground) return vec3(0.7, 0.5, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.0005) return t;
        t += d * 0.7;  // conservative step for displacement
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d * 0.7;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.5);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## symmetry-abs

A few primitives in the positive octant, mirrored with abs(p) to get 8-fold symmetry.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.58, 0.52);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }
float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    // Fold into positive octant
    vec3 q = abs(p);
    // A sphere near the corner
    float s = sdSphere(q - vec3(1.2, 0.4, 0.2), 0.35);
    // A box along an edge
    float b = sdBox(q - vec3(0.0, 0.9, 0.9), vec3(0.6, 0.15, 0.15));
    float d = smin(s, b, 0.15);
    float ground = p.y + 1.8;
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = abs(p);
    float s = sdSphere(q - vec3(1.2, 0.4, 0.2), 0.35);
    float b = sdBox(q - vec3(0.0, 0.9, 0.9), vec3(0.6, 0.15, 0.15));
    float d = smin(s, b, 0.15);
    float ground = p.y + 1.8;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.85, 0.5, 0.2);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 6.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## infinite-repetition

A sphere tiled infinitely in xz with mod, on a ground plane.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.58, 0.58);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float s = 3.0;
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + s * 0.5, s) - s * 0.5;
    float sphere = sdSphere(q, 0.6);
    float ground = p.y + 1.0;
    return min(sphere, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float s = 3.0;
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + s * 0.5, s) - s * 0.5;
    float sphere = sdSphere(q, 0.6);
    float ground = p.y + 1.0;
    if (sphere < ground) return vec3(0.9, 0.4, 0.3);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 80.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 8.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    // Distance fog
    float fog = 1.0 - exp(-0.015 * t * t);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9), fog);
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## finite-repetition

## twist

A box twisted along the y-axis. Demonstrates the domain warp.

```glsl
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    // Twist
    float angle = 2.0 * p.y;
    float c = cos(angle), s = sin(angle);
    vec3 q = vec3(c * p.x - s * p.z, p.y, s * p.x + c * p.z);
    // Square cross-section column
    float col = sdBox(q, vec3(0.4, 2.0, 0.4));
    float ground = p.y + 2.0;
    // Pedestal
    float base = sdBox(p - vec3(0, -2.15, 0), vec3(0.7, 0.15, 0.7));
    return min(min(col, base), ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float angle = 2.0 * p.y;
    float c = cos(angle), s = sin(angle);
    vec3 q = vec3(c * p.x - s * p.z, p.y, s * p.x + c * p.z);
    float col = sdBox(q, vec3(0.4, 2.0, 0.4));
    float base = sdBox(p - vec3(0, -2.15, 0), vec3(0.7, 0.15, 0.7));
    float ground = p.y + 2.0;
    float shape = min(col, base);
    if (shape < ground) return vec3(0.9, 0.85, 0.75);
    return vec3(0.3, 0.28, 0.28);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d * 0.5;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d * 0.5;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 7.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## infinite-corridor

Repeated columns in xz forming an infinite colonnade with floor and ceiling.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.52, 0.52);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 1.0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    // Floor and ceiling
    float floor = p.y + 2.0;
    float ceiling = -(p.y - 4.0);

    // Repeated columns
    float s = 5.0;
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + s * 0.5, s) - s * 0.5;
    float column = sdCylinder(q, 0.35, 2.0);

    // Carve the central hallway: remove columns in a band
    float hallway = abs(p.z) - 2.0;

    float d = min(floor, ceiling);
    // Only place columns outside the hallway
    if (hallway > 0.0) d = min(d, column);
    else d = min(d, min(column, -hallway));  // keep columns, subtract hallway space

    return min(d, min(floor, ceiling));
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float floor = p.y + 2.0;
    float ceiling = -(p.y - 4.0);
    float s = 5.0;
    vec3 q = p;
    q.xz = mod(p.xz + s * 0.5, s) - s * 0.5;
    float column = sdCylinder(q, 0.35, 2.0);
    float d = min(min(floor, ceiling), column);
    if (d == column) return vec3(0.9, 0.85, 0.75);
    if (d == floor) return vec3(0.4, 0.35, 0.32);
    return vec3(0.5, 0.48, 0.45);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 60.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 8.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(0.5, 1, 0.3)), vec3(1, 0.95, 0.85));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.3, 0.4, 0.6);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.2, 0.22, 0.3) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.2 * sh;
    }
    float fog = 1.0 - exp(-0.008 * t * t);
    color = mix(color, vec3(0.3, 0.4, 0.6), fog);
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## symmetric-sculpture

Primitives in the positive octant, smooth-unioned, then abs(q) for octant symmetry.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.58, 0.48);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }
float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}
float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
    return length(q) - r;
}
float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = abs(p);
    // A sphere at the corner
    float s1 = sdSphere(q - vec3(1.0, 0.6, 0.3), 0.3);
    // A torus arm
    float t1 = sdTorus(q - vec3(0, 0, 0), 1.2, 0.12);
    // A connecting box
    float b1 = sdBox(q - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.5), vec3(0.12, 0.8, 0.12));

    float d = smin(s1, t1, 0.2);
    d = smin(d, b1, 0.15);
    float ground = p.y + 1.8;
    return min(d, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = abs(p);
    float s1 = sdSphere(q - vec3(1.0, 0.6, 0.3), 0.3);
    float t1 = sdTorus(q - vec3(0, 0, 0), 1.2, 0.12);
    float b1 = sdBox(q - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.5), vec3(0.12, 0.8, 0.12));
    float d = smin(s1, t1, 0.2);
    d = smin(d, b1, 0.15);
    float ground = p.y + 1.8;
    if (d < ground) return vec3(0.75, 0.55, 0.85);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 6.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## mug

Coffee mug: hollow cylinder + torus handle with smooth union.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.62, 0.52);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
    return length(q) - r;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float mugSDF(vec3 p) {
    // Outer body
    float outer = sdCylinder(p, 0.5, 0.5);
    // Inner cavity (shifted up to preserve bottom)
    float inner = sdCylinder(p - vec3(0, 0.05, 0), 0.45, 0.5);
    float body = max(outer, -inner);
    // Handle: torus at the side, intersected with half-space for arc
    vec3 hp = p - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.0);
    hp = hp.xzy;  // stand torus upright
    float torus = sdTorus(hp, 0.3, 0.07);
    float handle = max(torus, hp.y - 0.2);
    return smin(body, handle, 0.08);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float mug = mugSDF(p);
    float ground = p.y + 0.55;
    return min(mug, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float mug = mugSDF(p);
    float ground = p.y + 0.55;
    if (mug < ground) return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 3.5);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

```glsl
}

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
    return length(q) - r;
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

#define MAT_PLATE  0.0
#define MAT_DONUT  1.0
#define MAT_ICING  2.0
#define MAT_GROUND 3.0
float objID;

float plateSDF(vec3 p) {
    float base = sdCylinder(p, 1.0, 0.04);
    float ring = sdCylinder(p - vec3(0, 0.03, 0), 1.0, 0.03);
    float hole = sdCylinder(p - vec3(0, 0.03, 0), 0.8, 0.1);
    float rim = max(ring, -hole);
    return smin(base, rim, 0.06);
}

float donutSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = p - vec3(0, 0.23, 0);
    return sdTorus(q, 0.35, 0.15);
}

float icingSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 q = p - vec3(0, 0.23, 0);
    float icing = sdTorus(q, 0.35, 0.17);
    icing = max(icing, q.y + 0.02);
    icing += 0.008 * sin(40.0 * q.x) * sin(40.0 * q.y) * sin(40.0 * q.z);
    return icing;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float pl = plateSDF(p);
    objID = MAT_PLATE;

    float dn = donutSDF(p);
    if (dn < pl) { pl = dn; objID = MAT_DONUT; }

    float ic = icingSDF(p);
    float donutWithIcing = smin(dn, ic, 0.03);
    if (donutWithIcing < pl) {
        pl = donutWithIcing;
        objID = (ic < dn) ? MAT_ICING : MAT_DONUT;
    }

    float ground = p.y + 0.1;
    if (ground < pl) { pl = ground; objID = MAT_GROUND; }

    return min(min(plateSDF(p), min(donutSDF(p), icingSDF(p))), ground);
}

vec3 materialColor(float id) {
    if (id == MAT_PLATE)  return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);
    if (id == MAT_DONUT)  return vec3(0.8, 0.6, 0.35);
    if (id == MAT_ICING)  return vec3(0.9, 0.45, 0.55);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

// Simplified sceneSDF for raymarching (no material tracking)
float sceneD(vec3 p) {
    float pl = plateSDF(p);
    float dn = donutSDF(p);
    float ic = icingSDF(p);
    float donutAll = smin(dn, ic, 0.03);
    float ground = p.y + 0.1;
    return min(min(pl, donutAll), ground);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneD(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneD(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneD(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneD(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneD(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneD(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        float d = sceneD(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.0005) return t;
        t += d * 0.8;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneD(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        // Get material ID
        sceneSDF(p);
        float id = objID;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = materialColor(id);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## table

Table with box tabletop and four box legs, smooth-unioned.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.58, 0.55);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

float tableSDF(vec3 p) {
    float top = sdBox(p, vec3(2.0, 0.06, 1.2));
    float l1 = sdBox(p - vec3(-1.8, -0.56, -1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float l2 = sdBox(p - vec3(-1.8, -0.56,  1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float l3 = sdBox(p - vec3( 1.8, -0.56, -1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float l4 = sdBox(p - vec3( 1.8, -0.56,  1.0), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float legs = min(min(l1, l2), min(l3, l4));
    return smin(top, legs, 0.04);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float table = tableSDF(p);
    float ground = p.y + 1.1;
    return min(table, ground);
}

vec3 sceneColor(vec3 p) {
    float table = tableSDF(p);
    float ground = p.y + 1.1;
    if (table < ground) return vec3(0.55, 0.35, 0.2);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 7.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = sceneColor(p);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## breakfast-scene

The full scene: mug on saucer, plate with iced donut, all on a table.

```glsl
struct Ray { vec3 origin; vec3 dir; };
struct Light { vec3 dir; vec3 color; };

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(90.0) / 2.0);
    return Ray(vec3(0.0), normalize(vec3(uv, -f)));
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(1,0,0, 0,c,-s, 0,s,c); }
mat3 rotateY(float a) { float c = cos(a), s = sin(a); return mat3(c,0,s, 0,1,0, -s,0,c); }

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float dist) {
    vec2 m = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) m = vec2(0.58, 0.52);
    mat3 rot = rotateX((0.5 - m.y) * 3.14) * rotateY((m.x - 0.5) * 6.28);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0, 0.5, dist);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float r) { return length(p) - r; }
float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}
float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}
float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - R, p.y);
    return length(q) - r;
}
float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
}

// --- Mug ---
float mugSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 mp = p - vec3(-1.0, 0.62, 0.0);
    float outer = sdCylinder(mp, 0.5, 0.5);
    float inner = sdCylinder(mp - vec3(0, 0.05, 0), 0.45, 0.5);
    float body = max(outer, -inner);
    vec3 hp = mp - vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.0);
    hp = hp.xzy;
    float torus = sdTorus(hp, 0.3, 0.07);
    float handle = max(torus, hp.y - 0.2);
    return smin(body, handle, 0.08);
}

// --- Saucer ---
float saucerSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 sp = p - vec3(-1.0, 0.07, 0.0);
    float base = sdCylinder(sp, 0.7, 0.04);
    vec3 rp = sp - vec3(0, 0.03, 0);
    float ring = sdCylinder(rp, 0.7, 0.03);
    float hole = sdCylinder(rp, 0.55, 0.1);
    float rim = max(ring, -hole);
    return smin(base, rim, 0.06);
}

// --- Plate ---
float plateSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 pp = p - vec3(1.2, 0.07, 0.0);
    float base = sdCylinder(pp, 1.0, 0.04);
    float ring = sdCylinder(pp - vec3(0, 0.03, 0), 1.0, 0.03);
    float hole = sdCylinder(pp - vec3(0, 0.03, 0), 0.8, 0.1);
    float rim = max(ring, -hole);
    return smin(base, rim, 0.06);
}

// --- Donut with icing ---
float donutSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 dp = p - vec3(1.2, 0.3, 0.0);
    return sdTorus(dp, 0.35, 0.15);
}

float icingSDF(vec3 p) {
    vec3 dp = p - vec3(1.2, 0.3, 0.0);
    float icing = sdTorus(dp, 0.35, 0.17);
    icing = max(icing, dp.y + 0.02);
    icing += 0.008 * sin(40.0 * dp.x) * sin(40.0 * dp.y) * sin(40.0 * dp.z);
    return icing;
}

// --- Table ---
float tableSDF(vec3 p) {
    float top = sdBox(p, vec3(2.5, 0.06, 1.5));
    float l1 = sdBox(p - vec3(-2.3, -0.56, -1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float l2 = sdBox(p - vec3(-2.3, -0.56,  1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float l3 = sdBox(p - vec3( 2.3, -0.56, -1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float l4 = sdBox(p - vec3( 2.3, -0.56,  1.3), vec3(0.08, 0.5, 0.08));
    float legs = min(min(l1, l2), min(l3, l4));
    return smin(top, legs, 0.04);
}

// --- Material tracking ---
#define MAT_MUG    0.0
#define MAT_SAUCER 1.0
#define MAT_PLATE  2.0
#define MAT_DONUT  3.0
#define MAT_ICING  4.0
#define MAT_TABLE  5.0
#define MAT_GROUND 6.0
float objID;

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    float d = mugSDF(p);
    objID = MAT_MUG;

    float sc = saucerSDF(p);
    if (sc < d) { d = sc; objID = MAT_SAUCER; }

    float pl = plateSDF(p);
    if (pl < d) { d = pl; objID = MAT_PLATE; }

    float dn = donutSDF(p);
    float ic = icingSDF(p);
    float donutAll = smin(dn, ic, 0.03);
    if (donutAll < d) {
        d = donutAll;
        objID = (ic < dn) ? MAT_ICING : MAT_DONUT;
    }

    float tb = tableSDF(p);
    if (tb < d) { d = tb; objID = MAT_TABLE; }

    float ground = p.y + 1.1;
    if (ground < d) { d = ground; objID = MAT_GROUND; }

    return d;
}

vec3 materialColor(float id) {
    if (id == MAT_MUG)    return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);
    if (id == MAT_SAUCER) return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);
    if (id == MAT_PLATE)  return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.78);
    if (id == MAT_DONUT)  return vec3(0.8, 0.6, 0.35);
    if (id == MAT_ICING)  return vec3(0.9, 0.45, 0.55);
    if (id == MAT_TABLE)  return vec3(0.55, 0.35, 0.2);
    return vec3(0.35, 0.32, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float e = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(e,0,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(e,0,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,e,0)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,e,0)),
        sceneSDF(p+vec3(0,0,e)) - sceneSDF(p-vec3(0,0,e))));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(ray.origin + t * ray.dir);
        if (d < 0.0005) return t;
        t += d * 0.8;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p, vec3 ld) {
    float t = 0.05;
    for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
        float d = sceneSDF(p + ld * t);
        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;
        t += d;
        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 7.0);
    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1, 2, 1.5)), vec3(1, 0.97, 0.95));
    float t = raymarch(ray);
    vec3 color = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 0.9);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float id = objID;       // save before calcNormal clobbers it
        vec3 n = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 mat = materialColor(id);
        float sh = shadow(p + n * 0.01, light.dir);
        float diff = max(0.0, dot(n, light.dir));
        vec3 refl = reflect(-light.dir, n);
        float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(refl, -ray.dir)), 32.0);
        color = mat * vec3(0.25, 0.3, 0.4) + mat * light.color * diff * sh + light.color * spec * 0.3 * sh;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```
